items.name: as_pep_585_generic
items.signature: fn as_pep_585_generic(module: &str, member: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, &'static str)>
items.summary: Given a typing member, returns the module and member name for a generic from the Python standard library (e.g., `list` for `typing.List`), if such a generic was introduced by [PEP 585].

items.name: is_immutable_generic_type
items.summary: Returns `true` if a call path represents that of an immutable, generic type from the Python standard library (e.g. `tuple`).

items.name: is_immutable_non_generic_type
items.summary: Returns `true` if a call path represents that of an immutable, non-generic type from the Python standard library (e.g. `int` or `str`).

items.name: is_immutable_return_type
items.summary: Returns `true` if a call path represents a function from the Python standard library that returns a immutable value (e.g., `bool`).

items.name: is_literal_member
items.summary: Returns `true` if a name matches that of the `Literal` generic.

items.name: is_mutable_return_type
items.summary: Returns `true` if a call path represents a function from the Python standard library that returns a mutable value (e.g., `dict`).

items.name: is_pep_593_generic_member
items.summary: Returns `true` if a name matches that of a generic from [PEP 593] (e.g. `Annotated`).

items.name: is_pep_593_generic_type
items.summary: Returns `true` if a call path is a [PEP 593] generic (e.g. `Annotated`).

items.name: is_standard_library_generic
items.summary: Returns `true` if a call path is a generic from the Python standard library (e.g. `list`, which can be used as `list[int]`).

items.name: is_standard_library_generic_member
items.summary: Returns `true` if a name matches that of a generic from the Python standard library (e.g. `list` or `Set`).

items.name: is_standard_library_literal
items.summary: Returns `true` if a call path is `Literal`.

items.name: is_typed_dict_member
items.summary: Returns `true` if a name matches that of `TypedDict`.

items.name: simple_magic_return_type
items.summary: Returns the expected return type for a magic method.
